The row prices MRI and CT together and does not price them separately. Those items (5, 6, 7, 10, 17, 18, 21, 22) are named in the row, so a counselor reading "MRI, CT, etc." would agree that MRI costs $300 in network. The "etc." means the row also includes other tests, but MRI and CT are still covered at that price. I judge these true, though with some doubt. Some quotes are incomplete. Item 6 cites only "$300" with the label on a separate line. Items 3, 5 and 7 also split or truncate quotes, but the page content supports them. Item 1 quotes "Outpatient x-rays $10 50%" and states a $10 copay in network, which matches. Item 9 states 50% out of network, which also matches. Item 4 is out of network at 50%, which matches.
